paite: Huan kumpipa Herod vaihawm lai a Judia gam a, Bethlehem a Jesu ahong pian lai in, ngai in, suahlam a kipan Jerusalem ah mipilte ahong pai uhi.
heading: Mipilte' Vehna
english: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of King Herod, behold, wise men from the east came to Jerusalem, saying,

paite: "Koi ah ahia Judate' Kumpipa ahong pian? Suahlam ah ama aksi ka mu ua, amah be dia hong pai ka hi uh," achi uhi.
english: “Where is he who is born King of the Jews? For we saw his star in the east, and have come to worship him.”

paite: Kumpipa Herod in huai azak phet in alungzing a, Jerusalem tengteng leng alung uh azing sam hi.
english: When King Herod heard it, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.

paite: Huchi in siampu liante leh mite laigelhmi tengteng asamkhawm a, Khrist pianna ding thu adongta hi.
english: Gathering together all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he asked them where the Christ would be born.

paite: Huan amau akiang ah, "Judia gam a Bethlehem khua ah zawlnei in hichi in agelh akei hiam:
english: They said to him, “In Bethlehem of Judea, for this is written through the prophet,

paite: "Nang, Judia gam a Bethlehem aw, Judia khopite lak ah na neupen kei hial, na sung a kipan ukpa hong suak ding ahi ngal a, ka mi Israelte vengpa ding," chih, achi uhi.
english: ‘You Bethlehem, land of Judah, are in no way least among the princes of Judah; for out of you shall come a governor who shall shepherd my people, Israel.’”

paite: Huai nung in Herod in aguk in mipilte asam a, ngenteltak in aksi kilat lai adongkheta hi.
english: Then Herod secretly called the wise men, and learned from them exactly what time the star appeared.

paite: Huan amau Bethlehem ah apaisak a, "Paita unla, naungek thu ngenteltak in dongkhia un, ke'n leng amah ka hong biak theih samna ding in, na muh chiang un hong hilh un," achi hi.
english: He sent them to Bethlehem, and said, “Go and search diligently for the young child. When you have found him, bring me word, so that I also may come and worship him.”

paite: Huan kumpipa thu azak un apaita ua, ngai in suahlam a aksi amuh uh naungek omna tung zawn atun a akhawl masiah ama uah apai zel hi.
english: They, having heard the king, went their way; and behold, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them until it came and stood over where the young child was.

paite: Aksi amuh un, akipak lo mahmah uhi.
english: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceedingly great joy.

paite: Inn sung ah ava lut ua, anu Mari kiang a naungek om amuh un, abokkhup ua, abia uhi. Agoubawm uh ahong ua, akiang ah kipahna dangka-eng, begaw leh murrah alan uhi.
english: They came into the house and saw the young child with Mary, his mother, and they fell down and worshiped him. Opening their treasures, they offered to him gifts: gold, frankincense, and myrrh.

paite: Herod kiang a kik nawn lou ding in amang ua vauhilh a a-om ziak un, amau kholam, lam tuam ah apaita uhi.
english: Being warned in a dream not to return to Herod, they went back to their own country another way.

paite: Huan apai nung un, ngai in, Joseph kiang ah amang in Toupa angel akilak a, "Thou inla, naungek leh anu pi inla, Aigupta gam ah taipih in, ka hon hilh nawn masiah huai ah om gige in; Herod in naungek hihsiat dia zong ding ahih ziak in," achi hi.
heading: Aigupta A Jesu Khrist Taipihna / (Hos 11.1)
english: Now when they had departed, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream, saying, “Arise and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and stay there until I tell you, for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.”

paite: Huchi in athou a, azanzan in naungek leh anu api a, Aigupta gam ah apaita hi.
english: He arose and took the young child and his mother by night and departed into Egypt,

paite: Herod sih mateng huai ah a-om gige hi. Toupa'n zawlnei kam a, "Ka tapa Aigupta gam a pan ka samkhia," chi a agen ahong tuntheihna ding ahi.
english: and was there until the death of Herod, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying, “Out of Egypt I called my son.”

paite: Huchih lai in Herod in mipilte' khem a om ahih lam akitheihtak in aheh mahmah a, mi asawl a, ahun laitak thu ngenteltak a mipilte adotkhiak bang in, Bethlehem khua leh akim tengteng a pasal naupang kum nih chiang nuailam avek un athatta hi.
heading: Herod In Naupangte Athahna
english: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked by the wise men, was exceedingly angry, and sent out and killed all the male children who were in Bethlehem and in all the surrounding countryside, from two years old and under, according to the exact time which he had learned from the wise men.

paite: Huchih lai in zawlnei Jeremiah in:
english: Then that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying,

paite: "Ramah ah husa aza uh, suunna, kah thawm, misi ngai a mau vengvungte, Rakil in atate akah a, a-om nawn louh ziak un akhamuan theih kei," chi a ana gen ahong tungta hi.
english: “A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, weeping and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children; she wouldn’t be comforted, because they are no more.”

paite: Himahleh Herod asih nung in, ngai in, Aigupta gam a Joseph kiang ah Toupa Angel amang in akilak hi.
heading: Aigupta A Pan Kikna
english: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt, saying,

paite: "Thou inla, naungek leh anu pi inla, Israel gam ah pai in; naungek thah tumte asih tak ziak un," achi hi.
english: “Arise and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel, for those who sought the young child’s life are dead.”

paite: Huchi in athou a, naungek leh anu api a, Israel gam ah apaita uhi.
english: He arose and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.

paite: Himahleh Arkelaus in apa Herod sik in Judia gam ah vai ahawm chih azak in, huai lam a pai alau a; amang a vauhilh a a-om ziak in Galili gam ah apai a,
english: But when he heard that Archelaus was reigning over Judea in the place of his father, Herod, he was afraid to go there. Being warned in a dream, he withdrew into the region of Galilee,

paite: Nazaret kichi khua khat ah atengta hi. "Amah zaw Nazaret mi achi ding uh," chi a zawlneite na gen ahong tuntheihna ding in.
english: and came and lived in a city called Nazareth; that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophets that he will be called a Nazarene.
